build_axis_aligner_plan: build an axis aligner plan from a pair of dimension strings to generate einops rearrangement patterns
execute_axis_aligner_plan: execute an axis aligner plan on a torch tensor using a specified side pattern to rearrange dimensions
create_axis_aligner_plan_type: create an AxisAlignerPlan data structure holding einops patterns for x and y tensor sides
test_semantic_names_match: test whether two sides share the same semantic dimension names ignoring squeeze dims
build_canonical_order: build a canonical dimension order from two dim spec pairs following y with fused groups preserved
